backend.note: Statement, branch and toggle counters are the raw Verilator coverage records of the DUT source only. FSM state/transition and covergroup closure require a coverage-capable licensed backend and stay release evidence.

reporting.note: Partial percentages are reported as progress measurements while the suite is under construction; they are not release floors and are never silently waived.

not_applicable.fsm_state: Verilator emits no FSM state/transition records; the algorithm kernels use counter and shift-register control rather than declared enum state machines.
not_applicable.covergroups: SystemVerilog covergroups are unsupported by the portable backend; functional bins are implemented as explicit counters inside each testbench.

measurement.scope: The measured declaration of a context is the graph cu_control top of its layout; the census is the raw Verilator point list of that source only.
measurement.denominators: The raw found/hit denominators of every measured page are pinned per context so a change of instrumentation or of the declaration cannot move the census silently.
measurement.unreachable: Every point the deterministic stimulus never exercises carries a category from the categories map and an exact reason; a declared point that is exercised is reported as a stale declaration.

categories.algorithmic-constant: the declaration publishes a fixed value on the field
categories.configuration-range: the point belongs to a cluster the configuration word this suite publishes does not activate
categories.counter-range: the bit belongs to a monotonic event counter and would need more events than the bounded fixture and burst budget can produce
categories.disabled-path: the declaration drives the enable of the path with a hard coded zero, which the rule verifies in the source, so nothing inside the path can be exercised
categories.fixture-value-range: the bit belongs to a field that carries a graph value, and the independent fixture registry never reaches a value that changes it
categories.flow-control-unreachable: the producer honours an almost-full request signal, so the corresponding buffer level is structurally unreachable
categories.parameter-constant: the bit is driven by a module parameter, a coordinate of this elaboration or a hard coded literal, so it cannot change inside one elaboration
